# Daily AI Eval Report — 2026-09-25 (AI usage monitor)

## Bot allowance
- **90% left**, spoken by Shanta at 6:58 AM PT on Sep 25.
- Rose from **78%**. Logged as an **observation, not a refund**.
- Soft allowance: about **29%/day** until **Mon Sep 28, 8:00 AM PT**.
- Burn estimate from the observed drops: about **5.6%/day**. Well under the soft allowance.

## OpenRouter
- Balance: **~$19.49**
- Day: ~$0.0001 (soft cap $1.65)
- Week: ~$0.0006 (soft cap $11.50)
- Month: **$40.43** (soft cap $50.00)

Month spend is at about 81% of the $50 soft cap.

## Super Grok
- No spoken figure since the **Sep 24, 10:31 AM PT** reset.
- Prior cycle: about **93% used**.

## Hermes
- **18** Super Grok sessions landed real code.
- Still defaults to **grok-4.6** (`~/.hermes/config.yaml` `model.default`).
- Dashboard **:9119 is down**.

## Chat (:3001, last 1 day)
- 7 calls. **1 usable** (cohere).
- **3** Ollama calls logged as success with **zero tokens**.
- **2** 404s from the free nemotron slug on OpenRouter.

## HelpDesk
- No figures reported today.

## Proposals
1. Switch the Hermes idle model to flash (workstation → todo).
2. Drop or replace the free nemotron slug in Chat routing (code → todo; routing is Perl code, not config).
3. Stop counting zero-token Ollama calls as success (code → todo).

supergrok.note: No spoken figure since the Sep 24 reset

proposals.title: Switch Hermes idle model to flash
proposals.rationale: Hermes still defaults to grok-4.6 for idle and light turns. Super Grok allowance is better spent on the 18-session code work. Change the idle/default model to flash on the workstation. This is workstation config, so it becomes a todo and is not applied from /ai/eval.

proposals.title: Drop or replace the free nemotron slug in Chat routing
proposals.rationale: 2 of 7 Chat calls on :3001 were 404s from the free nemotron slug on OpenRouter. Routing preferences are Perl code (FREE_PREFERENCE list and the startup default catalog), not an allow-listed config, so this becomes a todo. Remove the slug(s) that 404, or replace with a live :free model, after checking the live OpenRouter model list.

payload.replacement: first live OpenRouter :free instruction model (verify on /api/v1/models)

proposals.title: Stop counting zero-token Ollama calls as success
proposals.rationale: 3 Ollama calls on :3001 were logged status=success with 0 tokens and no usable reply. They inflate the success rate. A call with 0 completion tokens and empty content should be logged as an error/empty result and should trigger the normal fallback.

payload.rule: success requires completion_tokens > 0 or non-empty content
